item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"query_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim","rationale":"Tracks query projection and query RMS normalization work; projection widths are fixed in this workload."},{"name":"key_value_elements","expression":"(hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[0] * encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) * attn.kv_inner_dim","rationale":"Tracks both key/value projections and key RMS normalization using the effective encoder sequence length."},{"name":"cross_attention","expression":"int(encoder_hidden_states is not None)","rationale":"Captures fixed overhead differences between self-attention and cross-attention entry paths."}],"hypothesis":"With fixed projection dimensions and single-threaded CPU execution, instruction count should be approximately affine in query and key/value element counts, with a small path-dependent overhead."}
